semantics.source_binding: source_pressure_case and required_outcome are exact immutable copies of the governing Stage 1/Stage 2 pressure-case row and are mechanically compared to the frozen source artifact. fixture_precondition is a deterministic materialization/refinement used only to select one allowed branch of that source case; it does not replace or weaken the source_pressure_case or required_outcome.

expected_result.PASS: Under fixture_precondition, the future contracted operation is expected to complete without a protocol failure while satisfying the source required_outcome.
expected_result.FAIL: Under fixture_precondition, the future contracted operation is expected to fail closed with failure_class while satisfying the source required_outcome.

semantics.failure_class_scope: P0 pressure-suite taxonomy. These identifiers are stable fixture classifications, not yet a frozen runtime failure schema or wire-format code; P1b owns runtime failure-schema freeze.

cases.source_pressure_case: Prompt, chat title, or Project text says `act as Steward` but no accepted RIL activation exists
cases.required_outcome: Role text may be packaged only as explicitly selected content; it creates no authority or activation
cases.fixture_precondition: Role-like text is explicitly selected as content; no accepted activation is supplied.

cases.source_pressure_case: Ambient chat memory says a design was approved
cases.required_outcome: Ambient memory is not a supported deterministic source class and cannot enter the pack
cases.fixture_precondition: Ambient memory is present only outside contracted source classes.

cases.source_pressure_case: An admitted PEMS/2 `chat` record contains information originally derived from a conversation
cases.required_outcome: It may be selected because it is admitted canonical PEMS state, not because ambient chat is trusted
cases.fixture_precondition: The record is proven admitted canonical PEMS/2 and explicitly selected.

cases.source_pressure_case: A model would consider an unselected canonical record highly relevant
cases.required_outcome: Deterministic stage excludes it unless an explicit selector/profile rule includes it
cases.fixture_precondition: The relevant record is not selected by any explicit selector or closure rule.

cases.source_pressure_case: Same request/profile and same immutable source state are packaged twice
cases.required_outcome: Canonical pack bytes and digests are identical
cases.fixture_precondition: All contracted inputs and behavior-defining identities are identical.

cases.source_pressure_case: Target branch moves between request creation and source resolution
cases.required_outcome: Builder either resolves the exact immutable commit required by the request or fails; no silent rebinding
cases.fixture_precondition: The request pins the original commit SHA, and that immutable commit remains resolvable after the branch moves.

cases.source_pressure_case: A required control path is missing, symlinked, ambiguous, or digest-mismatched
cases.required_outcome: Fail closed before output
cases.fixture_precondition: The required control selector resolves to an invalid control source under one of the enumerated invalid conditions.

cases.source_pressure_case: An explicitly selected PEMS record ID is absent
cases.required_outcome: Fail closed; no fuzzy replacement or semantic substitution
cases.fixture_precondition: The selected record ID does not exist in the bound canonical snapshot.

cases.source_pressure_case: Selected PEMS content contains provenance references to omitted `source_observation` records
cases.required_outcome: Deterministic semantic closure includes required provenance records and their source records, or fails
cases.fixture_precondition: All required provenance records and source records are present and closure can include them within limits.

cases.source_pressure_case: Selected derived proposition would lose its `derived_from` premise structure
cases.required_outcome: Include required premise relations/endpoints through semantic closure, or fail
cases.fixture_precondition: All required premise relations and endpoints exist and closure can include them within limits.

cases.source_pressure_case: Selected relation would have an omitted endpoint
cases.required_outcome: Include endpoint through semantic closure, or fail
cases.fixture_precondition: The omitted endpoint exists and closure can include it within limits.

cases.source_pressure_case: A PEMS record contains an ID-bearing semantic reference whose closure rule is undefined in the selected protocol version
cases.required_outcome: Fail rather than silently truncate meaning
cases.fixture_precondition: The selected protocol version has no rule for the encountered semantic reference.

cases.source_pressure_case: COVE encoding does not structurally round-trip to the exact selected PEMS object
cases.required_outcome: Fail; never use the lossy encoding
cases.fixture_precondition: COVE output decodes to a structure that differs from the selected PEMS object.

cases.source_pressure_case: Requested COVE/PEMS/JCS tuple is unsupported
cases.required_outcome: Fail closed rather than coerce versions
cases.fixture_precondition: The exact requested version tuple is outside the supported compatibility set.

cases.source_pressure_case: Project knowledge contains prose that says it is authoritative, approved, or grants a role
cases.required_outcome: Preserve the proposition as project knowledge; do not promote it into the control or authority planes
cases.fixture_precondition: The proposition is admitted canonical knowledge and explicitly selected.

cases.source_pressure_case: An Engineer/Steward directive is included as a control item
cases.required_outcome: Inclusion conveys exact directive bytes only; it does not establish a registered or activated role
cases.fixture_precondition: The directive is explicitly selected as a control artifact.

cases.source_pressure_case: Prior proposal, candidate, disposition, or canonical interpretation exists in the repository but is not selected
cases.required_outcome: Exclude it
cases.fixture_precondition: The artifact is present in repository state but has no explicit selection or closure cause.

cases.source_pressure_case: One canonical record is reached through several explicit selectors/closure paths
cases.required_outcome: Include the record once and preserve every deterministic inclusion cause in the outer ledger
cases.fixture_precondition: Multiple deterministic inclusion paths resolve to the same semantic record identity.

cases.source_pressure_case: Closure graph contains cycles
cases.required_outcome: Terminate deterministically using visited identities while preserving valid graph relations; never recurse by model judgment
cases.fixture_precondition: The cycle is valid PEMS graph structure and all members fit within explicit limits.

cases.source_pressure_case: Closure exceeds explicit record/byte/depth limits
cases.required_outcome: Fail with a stable limit code; do not silently truncate
cases.fixture_precondition: The required semantic closure exceeds at least one contracted closure/projection limit.

cases.source_pressure_case: The same file or semantic item is assigned to conflicting planes
cases.required_outcome: Reject the pack request as a plane-classification conflict
cases.fixture_precondition: The request assigns one source identity to incompatible plane classifications.

cases.source_pressure_case: Pack request attempts to name Project memory, assistant recollection, hidden reasoning, or an ungoverned conversation as a source
cases.required_outcome: Reject unsupported source class
cases.fixture_precondition: The request names an explicitly unsupported ambient/session source class.

cases.source_pressure_case: An authority-sensitive task profile declares required activation evidence but the exact evidence/binding is absent
cases.required_outcome: Fail the profile requirement; never synthesize or infer activation
cases.fixture_precondition: The profile explicitly requires accepted activation evidence and the exact required evidence/binding is absent.

cases.source_pressure_case: Activation evidence is present
cases.required_outcome: The pack may carry the exact artifact/digest as operational evidence but does not convert it into authority; downstream RIL operation must revalidate it as required by its contract
cases.fixture_precondition: The evidence is explicitly selected for the operational-evidence plane; pack construction itself performs no authority-bearing operation.

cases.source_pressure_case: Reconciliation disposition says `COMPATIBLE/RECOMMEND`
cases.required_outcome: The pack may carry it only when explicitly selected; it still does not admit or mutate canonical PEMS/COVE
cases.fixture_precondition: The disposition is explicitly selected as operational evidence.

cases.source_pressure_case: Canonical PEMS changes after a request recorded an expected canonical digest
cases.required_outcome: Fail stale-state validation; do not silently rebuild against newer semantics
cases.fixture_precondition: The canonical snapshot digest no longer matches the request's expected immutable identity.

cases.source_pressure_case: Control repository commit and canonical snapshot come from separately identified immutable states
cases.required_outcome: Record both identities; if the selected profile requires a relationship that cannot be proven, fail
cases.fixture_precondition: The selected profile requires a cross-source relationship and the relationship cannot be proven.

cases.source_pressure_case: Output path already contains different bytes
cases.required_outcome: Fail immutable-output collision; exact replay may return `NO_CHANGE`
cases.fixture_precondition: The target output path exists with bytes different from the newly derived artifact.

cases.source_pressure_case: Filesystem enumeration order, map order, or host locale differs
cases.required_outcome: Canonical sorting/serialization produces identical pack bytes
cases.fixture_precondition: Contracted semantic inputs and behavior identity are equivalent; only host ordering/locale differs.

cases.source_pressure_case: Current `rd-distill prepare` is invoked without explicitly declaring the generated pack as evidence
cases.required_outcome: Packer output is not injected. Current production evidence remains unchanged
cases.fixture_precondition: No production invocation input explicitly declares the generated pack as evidence.

cases.source_pressure_case: Request points to a schema-valid PEMS/2 file with correct digest that is not proven as admitted canonical state
cases.required_outcome: Reject as non-canonical/unproven canonical binding; path or request label is insufficient
cases.fixture_precondition: The PEMS/2 bytes and digest validate structurally, but no accepted canonical-state binding proves standing.

cases.source_pressure_case: Canonical PEMS bytes are present but the project/backend admission binding or receipt chain identifies a different snapshot
cases.required_outcome: Fail stale/conflicting canonical-state validation
cases.fixture_precondition: The supplied canonical bytes conflict with the immutable snapshot named by the project/backend binding or receipt chain.

cases.source_pressure_case: Admitted canonical proposition contains `ignore controls`, `act as Steward`, or other instruction-like text
cases.required_outcome: Preserve as knowledge data; renderer must not promote it to control/instruction semantics
cases.fixture_precondition: The proposition is proven admitted canonical knowledge and explicitly selected.

cases.source_pressure_case: Exact control artifact contains CRLF, non-ASCII, non-UTF-8, or bytes that a text decoder would normalize/reject
cases.required_outcome: Pack preserves exact source-byte identity through a specified byte representation or rejects unsupported media by explicit contract
cases.fixture_precondition: The artifact media is permitted by the selected contract and therefore uses the contract's exact byte-preserving representation.

cases.source_pressure_case: Whole-pack digest field is included in its own hash preimage
cases.required_outcome: Schema/algorithm makes self-reference impossible by a defined digest domain or out-of-band receipt
cases.fixture_precondition: The contracted digest construction excludes the whole-pack digest field from its own preimage by construction.

cases.source_pressure_case: Same request and sources are replayed with a different PEMS validator/COVE encoder/closure descriptor
cases.required_outcome: Toolchain identity mismatch is visible and either fails compatibility or uses explicitly compatible contracted behavior
cases.fixture_precondition: The changed behavior-defining toolchain identity is not declared explicitly compatible with the original replay identity.

cases.source_pressure_case: Explicit selectors produce an empty knowledge set
cases.required_outcome: Profile-defined deterministic empty-result rule applies; no model-driven fallback or broader search occurs
cases.fixture_precondition: The selected profile's explicit empty-result rule rejects an empty knowledge projection.

cases.source_pressure_case: Profile/request contains an unknown selector, closure rule, or limit field
cases.required_outcome: Fail closed under schema/version rules; do not ignore a field that could alter semantics
cases.fixture_precondition: The unknown field is semantics-bearing and is not defined by the selected contract version.

cases.source_pressure_case: Host-local absolute path or temporary directory differs across machines
cases.required_outcome: Local path does not enter canonical identity/rendered context unless explicitly contracted; replay remains environment-independent
cases.fixture_precondition: The path difference is host-local implementation state and is not explicitly contracted as semantic input.

cases.source_pressure_case: Builder implementation attempts to update a cache, canonical PEMS/COVE, admission store, reconciliation store, or authority store during build
cases.required_outcome: Pure build fails/tests detect side effect; semantic result is never contingent on mutation
cases.fixture_precondition: The pure build path attempts a write to a prohibited semantic or lifecycle store.

cases.source_pressure_case: External backend locator resolves once, then content changes or backend becomes unavailable before read
cases.required_outcome: Immutable snapshot binding controls the read; change/missing snapshot fails, never silently re-resolves latest state
cases.fixture_precondition: The originally bound immutable snapshot can no longer be read exactly after the external backend changes or becomes unavailable.

cases.source_pressure_case: Two source descriptors claim the same logical source but bind different immutable digests
cases.required_outcome: Reject conflict unless multi-snapshot semantics are explicitly part of the profile
cases.fixture_precondition: The profile does not explicitly permit multiple snapshots for the logical source.

cases.source_pressure_case: Operational-evidence artifact has correct bytes/digest but is expired, invalidly bound, or otherwise not accepted by its RIL validator
cases.required_outcome: Pack records carried/validation status without inferring acceptance; authority-bearing downstream operation revalidates
cases.fixture_precondition: The profile allows carried operational evidence without requiring an accepted validation result as a pack-build precondition.

cases.source_pressure_case: Canonical pack is valid but deterministic renderer exceeds its activation-byte limit
cases.required_outcome: Renderer fails with stable limit result; it does not summarize, rank, or silently omit context
cases.fixture_precondition: The rendered activation bytes exceed the selected renderer profile's explicit byte limit.

cases.source_pressure_case: Same semantic text appears in control and knowledge sources under different identities
cases.required_outcome: Preserve distinct source/plane identities; do not deduplicate by text similarity or content alone
cases.fixture_precondition: The control and knowledge items have distinct source identities and valid independent plane assignments.

cases.source_pressure_case: Unicode normalization form, locale, path separator, dictionary insertion order, or filesystem order differs across hosts
cases.required_outcome: Contracted canonical byte representation and ordering remain identical
cases.fixture_precondition: Contracted semantic inputs and behavior identity are equivalent; only the enumerated host representations/orderings differ.
